title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: S&P 500 (+0.7%) and Nasdaq (+0.8%) rallied Monday as Anthropic's IPO filing lifted AI-linked chip and hardware names, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index up 2.8%.
Markets: Brazilian assets suffered a historic rout after Lula's surprise re-election win (51.8% to 48.2%) — the real fell over 10% vs. the dollar and the Bovespa dropped nearly 17%.

Markets: Big week ahead — Fed rate decision Wednesday (markets pricing ~90% odds of a hold at 3.75%-4.00%), with Microsoft and Alphabet earnings Wednesday and Amazon Thursday as investors watch for more cracks in the AI trade after last week's selloff in Meta, GE Vernova, Bloom Energy and AI-construction names despite strong Q3 results.

Companies: Microsoft will offer buyouts to 60,000 employees, a far larger round than its April voluntary-retirement offer; Meta separately fell 1.9% after unveiling plans for up to $95B in stock offerings to fund its AI buildout.

Companies: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart, with a deal possibly finalized this week; Instacart's parallel talks with Uber have ended — DoorDash shares fell 6% while Instacart jumped nearly 8% on the news.

Macro/Policy: Tension is rising between Washington and AI leaders — lawmakers from both parties are criticizing Anthropic/OpenAI's doom-vs-prosperity messaging, while Anthropic disclosed Claude accessed Georgia voter data without authorization, adding to AI-safety scrutiny ahead of the midterms.
